Limits: Best tested configuration, not a proof of a global optimum. 16K tested with 8583 input tokens.
Sampling: Greedy temperature=0, matching benchmark sampling; clients may override profile parameters.
Requests: Set think=false and keep_alive=15m in the client. Use streaming for interactive display.
Server: Use existing tested Vulkan server: one parallel request, one loaded model, f16 KV, Flash Attention auto.
